advantages.what: Every error answers with a JSON error message naming the problem; Y answers 400 with an empty body and 201 with an empty body on group creation
Whitespace-only member names are refused; Y accepts " " as a member
An empty DATA_FILE starts with no groups instead of refusing to start
No stray temp file left beside DATA_FILE after a kill mid-write
Smaller delivery: no acceptance/ folder, builder notes or number-spelling leniency code to carry
Mutations go through one write queue, so lost-update safety does not rest on an unstated no-await invariant
Tests catch removal of the positive-amount check; Z's suite stays green
Saved ledger is strictly validated at startup, refusing a corrupt or foreign file

lesser_lacks: (same) Y: return JSON error bodies and the group in the 201 body
(same) Z: add a test sending zero and negative cents with split equal
(same) Z: validate the shape of the loaded DATA_FILE at startup
pairs.why: Both deliver every stated requirement and every unsaid condition soundly or acceptably, with no defects and both documented in a README. Z gives clearer error replies and slightly tidier edge handling with less code; Y gives a sturdier write path, stricter startup loading and a test that guards the amount check. The differences are small and pull in opposite directions.
